title: Update time-sync DIO fixtures for canonical signer IID
description: The fully merged Python correctness gate fails 18 authenticated-DIO/time-sync tests because python/tests/timing/test_time_sync.py::dio_envelope hard-codes IPv6 source fe80::2 while production _issue_authenticated_dio_from_ipv6 now correctly requires fe80::<PeerIdentity.iid> derived from the authenticated signer. This prevents tests from reaching their intended DIO option, mutation, concurrency, rekey, and time-policy assertions. Update the test helper/call sites to build the source address from the signer under test, retain explicit wrong-source negative coverage, and run the full timing suite.
